name: diff_text
description: Compare two texts given inline: a unified diff with a chosen number of context lines, side-by-side rows (and a rendered table), a word-level diff with [-removed-]{+added+} markers, line counts and similarity ratios as exact fractions. Built on Python's difflib, matching its unified_diff output and marking a missing final newline as GNU diff does.

from_name.description: Label of a in the --- header

to_name.description: Label of b in the +++ header

width.description: Column width of the rendered side-by-side table

catalog.source: Python standard library difflib (unified_diff, SequenceMatcher); the word-diff markers follow git diff --word-diff=plain
